This page records an assortment of technical notes I make for myself, mostly around math and machine learning. The prerequisites vary for each note and they tell no new tales, but I share them hoping you might find a glimmer of inspiration within the rabbit holes.

Please do include a backlink and cite these notes if you use them in any form. Each post features a copyable BibTeX entry and standard format attribution at the end.

Questions, comments, error-spotting? Drop me an email. I’d love to hear from you!
